items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: it would be Denny Ramble. Denny Ramble. That's the first thing they did.

ctx.x: What would they play when they turned the body loose?

Well the first thing they used to play, when they used to turn the body loose, before, I mean years ago, it would be Denny Ramble. Denny Ramble. That's the first thing they did. They wouldn't be twenty-five feet from the cemetery before Denny Ramble. Denny Ramble. Denny Ramble. Denny Ramble.
You know what we hear at funerals all the time, man? You know what number we hear? What? Bourbon Street Parade.
